text: Entry Requirements 1. General Requirements 1)Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens aged between 18 and 30 by September 1st, 2026, be mentally and physically healthy, and possess a valid regular passport. Applicants under the age of 18 should submit Guarantee Statement 2)Applicants should be a graduating senior high school student or hold a senior high school diploma with a satisfactory academic record. 2. Requirements about Nationalities 1)Foreign citizens of Chinese origin, including former Chinese citizens who have obtained foreign citizenship, as well as the non-Chinese descendants of present or former Chinese citizens, will have to follow the system instructions to fill in the basic information and upload the supporting documents based on the different citizenship status, and will be subject to a preliminary review of citizenship status by XMU during the admission stage and to verification of citizenship by the entry and exit administration department of China’s public security authorities. Applicants who fail to pass the preliminary review or verification of citizenship will be deemed to have forfeited their eligibility for admission, as well as the subsequent academic registration that they may obtain. 2)In accordance with Article 5 of the Nationality Law of the People’s Republic of China, a person whose parents are both Chinese citizens and have both settled abroad, or one of whose parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled abroad, shall not have Chinese citizenship if he/she was born outside China and has acquired foreign citizenship at birth. Starting in 2021, if such a person applies for the undergraduate’s program at XMU as an international student, in addition to meeting the University’s all other application requirements, he/she is required to have held a valid foreign passport or a proof of lawful acquisition of foreign citizenship for at least 4 years and have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30, 2026) (9 months of residence in a foreign country counts as a full year). The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence. This requirement is also applicable to residents of the Chinese Mainland, Taiwan, Hong Kong or Macao who have emigrated to a foreign country and obtained foreign citizenship and are applying for the undergraduate programs at XMU as international students. 3. Language Proficiency Requirement English proficiency requirements for English-medium programs TOEFL iBT Certificate: an overall minimum score of 80 (XMU's DI Code for TOEFL is C310) OR an IELTS Academic Certificate: an overall minimum score of 6.0 OR the English-as-medium-of-instruction Certificate from the high school where English is the primary language of instruction. OR other equivalent English proficiency certificates recognized by XMU Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from this requirement. 4. China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) score report. Note: The test language should be consistent with the program's medium of instruction
